text: Municipal census from 1847 lists seventeen residents of a house with only three rooms. Final entry notes: The Hendersons live in the walls between Tuesday and Wednesday.

Marginalia discovered in a 1203 psalter: The angels have been on strike since Michaelmas. All miracles this season are performed by understudies. The handwriting matches no known scribe but appears in fortythree manuscripts across Europe.

Weather station data from 1934: Temperature recorded as nostalgic for six consecutive days in February. Barometric pressure readings replaced with childhood addresses. Local newspaper reported it as unseasonably memorable.

Excavation in Mesopotamia, 2400 BCE site, recovered cuneiform tablet describing standardized time zones. Text includes phrase spring forward, fall back in protoAkkadian. Daylight saving time was not invented until 1916.
